course.title: Terraform — Complete Deep DevOps Course
course.description: A Terraform-specific, beginner-to-advanced course focused on real development and production workflows, with detailed concepts, practicals, dedicated tasks, security, troubleshooting and a complete learning-platform capstone.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the concepts required to learn this technology properly; no fixed cross-tool template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Understand Terraform from fundamentals to production usage.
Implement a production-style learning platform deployment.

modules.title: Infrastructure as Code Foundations
modules.description: Declarative infrastructure, desired state, providers and why IaC improves repeatability.

lessons.title: Infrastructure as Code Foundations
lessons.description: Declarative infrastructure, desired state, providers and why IaC improves repeatability.
learningObjectives: Apply Terraform in a real deployment workflow.
Explain security, scaling and failure considerations.

notes.text: Declarative infrastructure, desired state, providers and why IaC improves repeatability.

Understand infrastructure as code foundations as an engineering problem first and a tool feature second. The student should know what problem it solves, what happens behind the scenes at a high level, how it fits into a real deployment, and what can go wrong.

Infrastructure as Code Foundations becomes important when a learning platform moves from local development toward repeatable, secure and scalable delivery. The goal is to understand the operational trade-offs, not merely memorize commands.

notes.alt: Terraform Infrastructure as Code Foundations architecture diagram

items: Understand the desired state or workflow.
Identify the components and their relationships.
Understand failure, recovery and rollback behavior.

notes.code:

XADD learning-events * type lesson.completed studentId 101

items: Copying commands without understanding what they change.
